mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate level serves as a continuous signal of monetary policy stance.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the positive return signal from the interaction is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in more than 50% of the 5-day forward return periods.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals economic weakness and potential central bank stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the average 60-day return in high-unemployment periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 220 indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the average 20-day return in high-inflation periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor market conditions and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through sustained economic activity.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or the correlation between PAYEMS and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105, or the average 60-day return in contraction periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
